status: CANDIDATE ONLY: not adopted, not frozen, not product evidence; independent scrutiny and adoption are separate
independence: standard library only; no product code/output/frozen product reference imported, read or run; invented controls labelled

model.section_note: areas/inertias are coefficients of pi; A_n nominal (stiffness), A_r reduced, A_i = r_i,r^2 pressure bore; kappa = kappa_E (DEL-05-03 §3.1) on the nominal annulus
model.theory: exact mathematical model with declared decimal inputs, not product binary64 leaves; product binding uses scaled tolerance, not bit equality; decimal fields are informational midpoint displays; small-displacement linear elastic straight 3-D frame; s scales E and G of the mapped body; Poisson pair 2 nu p A_i unscaled; caps -p A_i s_into at transferring terminals; N_w = N_m + 2 nu p A_i; S = N_w - p A_i

sign_conventions.end_wrench_on_member: force/moment exerted ON the member BY its end node, moment about that end node; local = (k T u - f_eq), global = T^T local; at the to end local Fx = +N_w (tension positive), at the from end local Fx = -N_w
sign_conventions.local_axes: x = (x_to - x_from)/L; y = normalized(y_ref - (y_ref.x) x); z = x cross y (frame kernel convention)
sign_conventions.reaction: force/moment ON the structure FROM the support, moment about the anchored node: R = K u - f
sign_conventions.dof_order: ux, uy, uz, rx, ry, rz per node; Timoshenko rotations are section rotations
sign_conventions.Poisson_eigen_pair: f_eq local: +2 nu p A_i at from, -2 nu p A_i at to (index 0 and 6)

model.exact_form: value = (sum_m c_m * prod sqrt(b_i)) * pi^k, c_m rational; forces k=1 and displacements k=0 in pressure cases; forces k=0 and displacements k=-1 in mechanical cases; 'binary64' is null when the rational enclosure (pi to 1e-100, square roots to 1e-70) does not decide the rounding

formulations.K: assembled 3-D frame stiffness, exact Gauss-Jordan over the field
formulations.FM: force method on the cantilever released at C (six redundants by exact unit-load compatibility) or the determinate cantilever; Poisson as eigenstrain; Simpson integration exact for the quadratic densities (no interior loads)

row_semantics.units: SI: N, N*m, m, rad, Pa. Product element stress rows are MPa (compare after exact conversion x 1e6); membrane, Lame and maximum rows are Pa
row_semantics.section_action_j_side_local: action exerted ON the from-side part BY the to-side part across the cut, element-local frame (x = (x_to - x_from)/L, y from y_reference, z = x cross y); end_i equals MINUS the from-end action on the member, end_j equals the to-end action on the member. Product interior local force/moment rows and stress recovery use this j-side convention; endpoint local force/moment rows are node-on-member end-DOF actions and bind to end_wrench_on_member_local instead. Axial is the wall force N_w (N_m = N_w - 2 nu p A_i and S = N_w - p A_i are constant along the member)
row_semantics.stations: end_i (0), quarter_1 (1/4), midspan (1/2), quarter_3 (3/4), end_j (1) of the member length from the from node
row_semantics.axial_membrane_Pa: N_w / A_b (pipe_axial_membrane_stress_v2 on a pressurized pressure-2 member; element_local_axial_normal_stress outside every pressure region, where N_w = N); equals the cleared axial_membrane_stress_Pa
row_semantics.bending_normal_y_Pa: element_local_bending_normal_stress_y = M_y / Z_b, signed; tension at the +z outer fibre when positive
row_semantics.bending_normal_z_Pa: element_local_bending_normal_stress_z = M_z / Z_b, signed; tension at the -y outer fibre when positive
row_semantics.outer_fibre_normal_stress: sigma_x(y, z) = sigma_N + sigma_y z / r_o - sigma_z y / r_o on the outer surface (= N/A + M_y z/I - M_z y/I)
row_semantics.torsional_shear_Pa: element_local_torsional_shear_stress = T r_o / J_b, signed with T (right-hand about +x on the j-side face)
row_semantics.normal_extreme_plus_Pa: element_local_normal_stress_extreme sigma+ = sigma_N + hypot(sigma_y, sigma_z) at the outer fibre r_o(-sigma_z, sigma_y)/hypot (fibre not emitted here); a signed normal-stress envelope, not a combined, Tresca, equivalent or code stress
row_semantics.normal_extreme_minus_Pa: element_local_normal_stress_extreme sigma- = sigma_N - hypot(sigma_y, sigma_z) at the opposite fibre
row_semantics.transverse_shear_maximum_Pa: element_local_transverse_shear_stress_maximum = |V| ((3+2nu) r_o^2 + (1+2nu) r_i,b^2) / (4 (1+nu) I_b), nonnegative Saint-Venant maximum on the inner surface at the fibres normal to V; torsional shear separate
row_semantics.max_abs_normal_Pa: |sigma_N| + hypot(sigma_y, sigma_z) at the station (informational per station)
row_semantics.member_maximum_abs_normal_Pa: max over the whole member of |N_w|/A_b + hypot(M_y, M_z)/Z_b (DEL-05-03 §2.1 member maximum; pipe_elastic_normal_stress_maximum_v2 on ordinary exact straight members, including per-member body rows; component_body members are excluded from case maxima and headlines); a normal-stress maximum only, torsional and transverse shear separate
row_semantics.maximum_proof: No interior load acts on any member (caps and the Poisson pair are end actions), so N_w, V and T are constant and M_perp(xi) = M_perp(0) + xi (M_perp(1) - M_perp(0)) is affine. xi -> |M_perp(xi)| is a norm of an affine map, hence convex, and |N_w|/A_b is constant, so the maximum over [0, 1] is attained at an endpoint. The governing endpoint is decided by the exact sign of |M_perp(0)|^2 - |M_perp(1)|^2 in the case field; equality makes both endpoints govern, and a constant M_perp makes every station tie. No sampling is used. The same convexity gives max sigma+ and min sigma- at an endpoint; T and |V| are constant.
row_semantics.exact_text: exact is given for field values; hypot-type rows (sigma+-, transverse shear maximum, maxima) are (a + c sqrt(q)) pi^k with q = M_y^2 + M_z^2 or V_y^2 + V_z^2 of the same station; their exact key is omitted; zero scales retain exact expressions with the entire sum grouped before pi^k; their binary64 is decided from rigorous rational enclosures (70 to 560 digits) only when both endpoints round alike

criterion.rule: a row passes when |observed - expected| <= 1e-9 * max(|expected|, zero_scale of its family and scope)

families.translation: m; per case: largest |u_x|, |u_y|, |u_z| over unanchored nodes
families.rotation: rad; per case: largest |r_x|, |r_y|, |r_z| over unanchored nodes; all zero -> translation scale / L_ref, L_ref = longest member chord of the case
families.reaction_force: N; per case: largest reaction force component; all zero -> largest member force scale of the case
families.reaction_moment: N*m; per case: largest reaction moment component; all zero -> reaction force scale * L_ref
families.member_force: N; per member: largest of its end-wrench force components (local and global), N_w, N_m, S and station N_w, V_y, V_z
families.member_moment: N*m; per member: largest of its end-wrench moment components (local and global) and station T, M_y, M_z; all zero -> member force scale * member chord length
families.normal_stress: Pa; per member and basis: largest |row| of sigma_N, sigma_y, sigma_z, sigma+, sigma- and the member maximum (= the member maximum); all zero -> member force scale / A_b
families.shear_stress: Pa; per member and basis: largest of |tau_T| and the transverse shear maximum; all zero -> member force scale / A_b
families.pressure_stress: Pa; per section, pressure and basis: the Lame hoop inner value (>= p); see lame_zero_scales_Pa

criterion.independence: every scale is a function of independent expected values and declared inputs (lengths, areas) only; none is chosen from product output or observed error; units never mix
criterion.same_as_2a: the governing 2a product tests use the same 1e-9 relative criterion; their zero-scale fallbacks are not changed by this package
